quarterly_data.quarter: Credo press release: Credo Expands ZeroFlap Portfolio with 224G-Based 1.6T (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Credo announced its 224G-based family of 1.6T ZeroFlap (ZF) optical transceivers, which combine its 224G-per-lane optical DSP with its Kfir200 silicon photonics PIC and its latest PILOT diagnostics platform - per Credo, the first products to incorporate its DSP with its own SiPho PIC. The family delivers 1.6T aggregate bandwidth in 2xDR4, 2xFR4 and DR8 form factors for AI scale-out, with OCP-standard ZeroFlap link telemetry, bidirectional remote telemetry, remote firmware update, non-volatile event logging, SONiC compatibility, and integrated or riding heat sink variants for switch-side and server-side use. It extends the 800G ZeroFlap AEC and Optics reliability architecture to 1.6T ports. No availability or shipment date is given in the release.
quarterly_data.figure: 1.6T (224G per lane) ZF transceivers: DSP + Kfir200 SiPho PIC; 2xDR4 / 2xFR4 / DR8
